title: Canonical integral ringed proper and compactification projection maps
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$, use the completed-coefficient derived category $\mathcal I_W=D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W})$ and its tensor calculus [def-sf-integral-system-operations]. Fix the normalized ringed models $d$ and open comparisons $b$ of [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]; write $\otimes_W$ for their ordinary derived tensor, $P_v$ for their ringed inverse image, $S_v$ for their ringed derived direct image with $P_v\dashv S_v$, and $J_j$ for their ringed open extension. For a morphism $v:X\to Y$ and arbitrary $M\in\mathcal I_X$, $N\in\mathcal I_Y$, define the ringed proper projection $\pi_v:S_vM\otimes_Y N\to S_v(M\otimes_XP_vN)$ to be the counit-defined right-adjoint projection mate of the canonical tensor/pullback comparison, as in [def-exchange-projection]. For a chosen compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,p:\overline X\to Y)$ of $f=pj$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], define the ringed compactification projection, for arbitrary $M\in\mathcal I_X$ and $N\in\mathcal I_Y$, by the composite $$S_pJ_jM\otimes_YN\xrightarrow{\pi_p}S_p(J_jM\otimes_{\overline X}P_pN)\xrightarrow{S_p(b_j)}S_pJ_j(M\otimes_XP_jP_pN)\xrightarrow{S_pJ_j(1\otimes\kappa)}S_pJ_j(M\otimes_XP_fN),$$ where $b_j$ is the specified canonical open tensor comparison and $\kappa:P_jP_p\cong P_f$ is the inverse pullback compositor followed by the compactification equation. These definitions introduce the displayed canonical maps; they assert neither invertibility nor a realization theorem.

lean.statement:
def ringedCompactificationProjection (d : RingedModels l E)
    (a : RingedOpenComparisons l E d) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (cf : Compactification f) (M : Integral l E X) (N : Integral l E Y) :
    (d.tensor Y).ordinary.tensor.obj
      ((ringedPush l E cf.g).obj ((ringedOpen l E cf.i).obj M), N) ⟶
    (ringedPush l E cf.g).obj ((ringedOpen l E cf.i).obj
      ((d.tensor X).ordinary.tensor.obj (M, (ringedPull l E f).obj N)))
